abstract_sentences.text: Online conformal prediction (OCP) seeks prediction intervals that achieve long-run 1 − α coverage for arbitrary (possibly adversarial) data streams, while remaining as informative as possible.
Existing OCP methods often require manual learning-rate tuning to work well, and may also require algorithm-specific analyses.
Here, we develop a general regret-to-coverage theory for interval-valued OCP based on the (1 − α)-pinball loss.
Our first contribution is to identify linearized regret as a key notion, showing that controlling it implies coverage bounds for any online algorithm.

evidence.anchor: linearized regret as a key notion

abstract_sentences.text: This relies on a black-box reduction that depends only on the Fenchel conjugate of an upper bound on the linearized regret.
Building on this theory, we propose UP-OCP, a parameter-free method for OCP, via a reduction to a two-asset portfolio selection problem, leveraging universal portfolio algorithms.
We show strong finite-time bounds on the miscoverage of UP-OCP, even for polynomially growing predictions.
Extensive experiments support that UP-OCP delivers consistently better size/coverage trade-offs than prior online conformal baselines.

experimental_design.name: OCP task and score
experimental_design.description: At round t the method outputs a centered interval and uses the absolute residual as its nonconformity score.

experimental_design.name: Real financial data
experimental_design.description: Four daily log-scale US stock opening-price streams from 2008–2018; Prophet is refit daily.

experimental_design.name: Electricity data
experimental_design.description: New South Wales electricity-demand records use a lag-3 AR predictor; Appendix L gives the May 1996 to December 1998 range.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic sinusoid
experimental_design.description: Scores are sinusoidal Gaussian-noise sequences with P=200, S_mag=10, S_min=2, sigma=0.3, and T=3000.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic stationary waves
experimental_design.description: A constant baseline, Bernoulli(0.1) exponential spikes, and a rolling-max window W=25 create locally correlated waves.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic quadratic drift
experimental_design.description: A quadratic 0-to-20 trend is combined with the same sparse noise and rolling max pooling.

experimental_design.name: Baseline suite
experimental_design.description: The compared methods are KT, DtACI, SF-OGD, and Conformal P/PI; bounded-score methods are excluded.

evidence.anchor: do not rely on prior knowledge

experimental_design.name: Hyperparameter policy
experimental_design.description: Parameterized baselines are chosen by ex-post grid search, which the authors explicitly call an oracle advantage; UP-OCP, KT, and DtACI are called parameter-free.

experimental_design.name: Time controls
experimental_design.description: AXP has a 100-day initial forecaster training period; full AXP plots discard 50 evaluation days and compute 100-day rolling local quantities.

experimental_design.name: Random-seed aggregation
experimental_design.description: Synthetic results average 10 independent seeds and Figure 4's bars are standard errors of the mean on both axes.

experimental_design.name: Metrics and test scope
experimental_design.description: The paper reports temporal marginal coverage, consecutive errors, mean/quantile set sizes, Pareto sweeps, and target tracking; it uses standard non-adversarial benchmarks because adversarial construction is described as extremely difficult.

evidence.anchor: coverage alone is a meaningless metric

experimental_design.name: Implementation, hardware, and formal statistical tests
experimental_design.description: No hardware budget, code repository, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison procedure, bootstrap, or Bayesian analysis is specified in the reviewed PDF.

result_inventory.claim: UP-OCP has finite-time coverage under polynomial score growth.
result_inventory.value: Theorem 4.4 bounds |T^-1 sum g_t| by epsilon_T plus a square-root epsilon_T term.
result_inventory.comparison: Compared analytically with OSD and KT bounds.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Deterministic finite-time theorem; no sampling statistic.

result_inventory.claim: On AXP, UP-OCP has smaller average set size and a shorter longest error run than KT at alpha=0.05.
result_inventory.value: UP: coverage 0.932, longest error sequence 4, average size 14.8; KT: 0.920, 15, 16.9.
result_inventory.comparison: KT, DtACI, and tuned SF-OGD in Table 1.
result_inventory.statistical_method: One historical time-series aggregate; no uncertainty interval or hypothesis test reported.

result_inventory.claim: DtACI has infinite upper-tail/mean set-size behavior in the AXP table.
result_inventory.value: Average size and 90%/95% quantiles are infinity while marginal coverage is 0.956.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Deterministic table aggregate; no distributional uncertainty reported.

result_inventory.claim: The authors interpret UP-OCP as the best AXP average-size Pareto trade-off over 50 target levels.
result_inventory.value: The claimed coverage range is 0.75 to 0.95 with UP-OCP closest to bottom-left.
result_inventory.comparison: UP, KT, SF-OGD, P Ctrl, and PI Ctrl; DtACI excluded for infinity.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Curve sweep over 50 alpha values, not an inferential test.

result_inventory.claim: Target coverage tracking is shown within a plotted plus-or-minus 0.03 tolerance band on AXP.
result_inventory.value: Figure 2 shows observed against target coverage for alpha in [0.05, 0.25].
result_inventory.statistical_method: Visual tolerance band; no statistical confidence procedure reported.

result_inventory.claim: Synthetic sinusoid experiments show UP-OCP tracking periodic width changes and a 10-trial Pareto display.
result_inventory.value: P=200, T=3000, 10 trials; Figure 4 reports SEM along both axes.
result_inventory.comparison: KT, DtACI, SF-OGD, P Ctrl, and PI Ctrl as plotted.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Mean over 10 independent trials with SEM in Figure 4.

result_inventory.claim: The additional stock tables repeat a favorable UP-versus-KT average-size/correctness pattern while DtACI's average size is infinite.
result_inventory.comparison: KT and the full tuned baseline suite.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Single historical series per ticker; no replicated sampling uncertainty reported.

result_inventory.claim: On electricity, UP has average size 0.507 and coverage 0.933 versus KT 0.518 and 0.927.
result_inventory.value: DtACI average size is infinity; P/PI and SF-OGD report 0.95 marginal coverage with larger average sizes.
result_inventory.comparison: KT, DtACI, SF-OGD, P Ctrl, PI Ctrl.

result_inventory.claim: Stationary-wave and quadratic-drift tables show trade-offs rather than UP winning every individual size cell.
result_inventory.value: Stationary UP/P: coverage 0.952/0.949 and average size 592/566; quadratic UP/P: 0.951/0.947 and 433/429.
result_inventory.comparison: UP against KT, DtACI, SF-OGD, P, and PI.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Synthetic tables; Appendix L states 10-seed averaging for synthetic experiments.

result_inventory.claim: Three Appendix M examples display failure modes of poorly selected baseline hyperparameters.
result_inventory.value: SF-OGD lr=0.01 coverage nearly 0%; P lr=0.05 oscillates; PI lr=0.0 stays effectively constant.
result_inventory.comparison: Each plot contrasts the baseline with UP-OCP.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Illustrative cases, not a full-grid failure-rate analysis.

ablation_inventory.name: UP-OCP component-removal ablation
ablation_inventory.description: No figure or table removes the conformal-market encoding, the Jeffreys prior, or radius clipping from UP-OCP. Appendix M varies baselines rather than UP components.

ablation_inventory.name: Target-level sweep
ablation_inventory.description: The AXP Pareto plot sweeps 50 target miscoverage rates uniformly from 0.05 to 0.25, testing operating-point sensitivity rather than a component mechanism.

ablation_inventory.name: Baseline hyperparameter sensitivity
ablation_inventory.description: Appendix M gives three failure illustrations for parameterized baselines, but does not quantify a full-grid rate of failure.

claim_closure.claim: Linearized regret is a general sufficient condition for OCP coverage.
claim_closure.method_response: Define linearized regret on pinball gradients.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 3.1 plus Appendix A proof and Appendix C asymptotic corollary.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion restates coverage from linearized regret.

claim_closure.claim: UP-OCP is a parameter-free universal-portfolio implementation of the sufficient condition.
claim_closure.method_response: Two-stock conformal market, wealth process, and radius map.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 4.3, proof in Appendix E, and closed-form update in Appendix G.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion names UP-OCP as the proposed strategy.

claim_closure.claim: UP-OCP obtains finite-time miscoverage bounds under polynomially growing scores.
claim_closure.method_response: Apply UP wealth to KL control of empirical miscoverage.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 4.4 and its explicit inversion proof.

evidence.anchor: Best-constant wealth equals an exact KL term

claim_closure.claim: UP-OCP has consistently better size/coverage trade-offs than prior baselines.
claim_closure.method_response: The method supplies a common radius/coverage output for comparison.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Main AXP and sinusoid results plus Tables 2–9 and appendix Pareto plots.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion does not qualify the empirical scope beyond future directions.

evidence.anchor: diverse set of real-world and synthetic benchmarks

claim_closure.claim: No-regret pinball learning gives oracle average width in a stochastic setting.
claim_closure.method_response: Assume i.i.d. scores, compact support, and density lower bound.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem D.3 is a proof; no direct stochastic width-convergence experiment is supplied.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion does not revisit this extension.

limitations.name: No standalone limitations section
limitations.description: The main text has a Discussion section but no separately titled limitations section; boundaries are distributed across setup, experiments, and open directions.

limitations.name: Prediction-set scope
limitations.description: The main setup analyzes centered symmetric intervals; richer prediction sets and conditional/feature-dependent validity are future directions.

limitations.name: Score-growth assumption
limitations.description: Finite-time results assume S_t is bounded by D t^q for D>0 and q>=0.

limitations.name: Stochastic-efficiency assumptions
limitations.description: Appendix D needs i.i.d. scores, compact support, a PDF, and a density lower bound to connect regret to oracle-width convergence.

limitations.name: Experimental non-adversarial scope
limitations.description: The authors say adversarial online testing is extremely difficult and therefore choose standard non-adversarial benchmarks.

limitations.name: Baseline-selection boundary
limitations.description: Parameterized baselines are selected ex post and the authors say this may overestimate their performance.

limitations.name: alpha correction is heuristic
limitations.description: Appendix J calls the proposal a heuristic because online coverage cannot be guaranteed at every individual time step.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: Appendix migration of full comparisons
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The main text says control-method full results and several datasets are deferred because of space, while pp.31–63 carry the detailed tables and plots.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: Average-size prioritization
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The main AXP Pareto plot prioritizes mean set size to penalize infinite-radius outputs; later appendix plots add median and 75% quantile views.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: Explicit oracle-advantage disclosure
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The paper directly says ex-post baseline tuning grants an oracle advantage and may overestimate baseline performance.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: No inferred concealment intent
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The PDF supports placement and metric choices but does not state an intent to hide adverse results; such intent is not inferred.

measurement_disagreements.name: Appendix-start provisional metric
measurement_disagreements.description: The automatic row reports appendix_start_page_provisional=14, but rendered pp.13–15 are References and Appendix A begins on p.16. This reading uses p.16.

measurement_disagreements.name: Figure-caption count
measurement_disagreements.description: The automatic draft reports 65 figure captions, whereas manual visual inventory has continuous labels Figure 1 through Figure 80. Multi-panel and repeated-caption extraction is the likely source of the discrepancy, but the parser cause is unavailable.

measurement_disagreements.name: Algorithm 2 score notation
measurement_disagreements.description: The main setup and Algorithm 1 use the absolute residual, while rendered Algorithm 2 writes S_t=Y_t-Yhat_t without visible absolute bars. Whether this is a typesetting omission is uncertain.

measurement_disagreements.name: Separate supplementary material
measurement_disagreements.description: No separate supplementary path is supplied; all extended material appears inside the 63-page PDF after Appendix A.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 OCP 的误覆盖转为 pinball 子梯度和，以 linearized regret 提供一般充分条件，再以不对称两资产 universal portfolio 实现 parameter-free UP-OCP，最后以 size/coverage Pareto 曲线展示后果（pp.4–12）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题、损失与梯度、Theorems 3.1/4.3/4.4、Algorithm 1、AXP 与 sinusoid 的核心图表；这让读者能理解选择 UP 的因果链（pp.3–12）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录移动了全部证明、closed-form 推导、baseline 更新与超参、全量追加实验和失败案例（pp.16–63）；跨数据主张因此依赖附录阅读。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 理论上按误覆盖指标→gradient sum→Fenchel duality→wealth 逐层闭环；实验上联合报告 Pareto、尾部尺寸和连续误覆盖，避免 coverage 单指标（pp.4–10）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 实验不是 adversarial benchmark，真实数据多为单时序，parameterized baselines 经 ex-post tuning，且没有 UP 组件删除式消融；因此“consistently better”的范围是部分闭合而非普遍定理（pp.8–10,36–63）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对于在线有效性任务，先寻找直接约束目标误差频率的优化量，再给出可计算的 parameter-free 实例，并用效用相关联合指标闭合理论到实证。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则需要任务误差能写成可控的累积优化量；它不自动保证 conditional validity、逐时刻 coverage、任意部署场景效率或组件因果性。
